sentences.english_text: Down below, the young man had arrived with a very tall ladder.
He moved through the crowd up to the foot of the statue and placed the ladder against the statue.
It just reached to the very top where Drippy was.
The priest handed the young man a small metal box.
Here, you can put the tear in this, but be very careful.
Don't let anything happen to it.
I won't, the young man promised.
And as the crowd watched, he started up the ladder, holding the box very carefully.
When he reached the eye of the statue, he slowly moved the box until it was directly under Drippy.
Then he pressed the box against the statue and raised it a bit so that Drippy fell into the box.
But it was an easy fall, and Drippy lay back in the box, relaxing.
From down below, he could hear the crowd cheering.
Cheering him.
It was so pleasant to be famous.
He felt the young man going down the ladder, holding the box very carefully.
Yes, I'm a treasure now.
There was no lid on the box so he could look up at the blue sky as he got closer and closer to the ground.
There was no lid on the box so he could look up at the blue sky as he got closer and closer to the ground.
The little box was very comfortable.
I might even take a bit of a nap here before I go to Rome.
